messages:
maya: Heads up — after the TS SDK telemetry patch rolled this morning we're seeing a ~40% drop in token counts for some API keys in the console. Affects only a subset of customers, looks like a sampling change. Anyone else seeing this?

devin: Which SDK version landed? I think 2.14.0 introduced the new sampling header. @maya can you paste an example request/headers from the proxy logs?

maya: pasted one from logs: 
```POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_...
Content-Type: application/json
X-RD-Telemetry: v2;sample=10
X-RD-SDK: ts/2.14.0

{"model":"redwood-1"}```

sam: ok, that's the new telemetry v2 header. Server-side quota counting pipeline currently expects either no sampling header or the old x-rd-sample header. If the pipeline treats v2 as sampled it might be dividing counts by the sample factor and undercounting in the dashboard.

lin: confirmed — metrics pipeline's ingress mapper looks for `x-rd-sample` and `x-rd-sampled` (legacy). v2 header format `X-RD-Telemetry: v2;sample=10` isn't parsed by the mapper, so requests fall back to default=1 and then downstream aggregator applies logic that results in lower visible tokens.

carla: two problems: billing/quota perception for customers, and rollout UX — many teams will flip to v2 for improved telemetry but see unexpected quota behavior. We should be careful with breaking telemetry semantics. Suggest: server fallback parsing for v2 header + a console-only shim that rehydrates historical dashboard views.

devin: proposed remediation plan: 1) add parser for v2 header in ingress mapper (server-side) to compute effective sample factor, 2) ship a canary that maps v2->legacy field for metrics, 3) add dashboard dimension `client_sdk_version` so we can filter and compare, 4) communicate to customers. Canary to 10% first.

maya: agreed. I can own the dashboard dimension change (quick query to validate). What's the deployment owner for server mapper?

devin: I'll own the mapper PR and the canary rollout. Will also add a short-term compatibility layer: if `X-RD-Telemetry` present, extract `sample` and set `x-rd-sample` header for the metrics pipeline. That way we don't need immediate reprocessing.

sam: snippet for header extraction I can drop into the proxy filter: 
```js
// extract sampling from X-RD-Telemetry v2
const hdr = req.headers['x-rd-telemetry'];
if (hdr) {
  const m = /sample=(\d+)/.exec(hdr);
  if (m) req.headers['x-rd-sample'] = m[1];
}
```

lin: console query for validation (prelim): 
```sql
SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens, client_sdk_version FROM metrics
WHERE time > now() - 24h
GROUP BY client_sdk_version
ORDER BY tokens DESC
```
This will show if ts/2.14.0 is underreporting.

carla: communication plan: status update to customers with high variance + opt-in telemetry v2 docs explaining sample semantics. Also, add a console banner if we detect mismatched counts for keys.

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy `routing-telemetry-fallback` to eng-prod: 10% at 1782002000 :rocket:

maya: thanks — after canary we should watch per-key usage for the affected customers and check billing deltas. I'll schedule a 30m sync once canary is stable.

devin: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/812 (adds v2 parser + header shim). Will monitor canary and revert if anything odd.

sam: quick follow-up: we should add unit tests for different header permutations (legacy, v2 with sample, v2 without sample). I'll add tests to the proxy-filter suite.

lin: noted for dashboards — I'll add `client_sdk_version` to the datasource and a quick tile on the routing health dashboard.

carla: tagging @support to prepare messaging templates for affected customers.

maya: ok locking owners: devin (server shim + canary), maya (dashboards + customer checks), sam (proxy tests), lin (console dimension + tile), carla (comms). Thanks all :thumbsup:
